lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: He is counting us.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I gave the wood one winter. I can give it another.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I heard it ask. I did not hear him say no.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I know. I saw.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I told Malrik no, once. Then I watched you carry three keys toward the Hollow.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I will hold the north stair, Bishop. Do what you came to do, and quickly.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: ...It knows my name.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Malrik. That light in your hand. It moved before you did.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Malrik. Your hand is shaking. Is that you, or the stone?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: No. I don't think you can.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Not yet. I think he was waiting for you. He is polite like that.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Now, Bishop. Before her roots take hold.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Now, Bishop. Before the spring remembers itself.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Quickly, then. Before that stone in your pocket finishes its sentence.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Run, little ember. Every relic you carry makes the Hollow hungrier. You will see.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: So be it. My lake will see you out. Slowly.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: So the little ember comes to warm the wood. You are late, child. Winter got here first.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Spring is stubborn. So is winter. This is not over, child.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: That ice has kept a secret for a hundred winters, ember. Think before you melt it.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: They have a watch. Take it back, or the ridge goes with it.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: This bank is mine until the thaw, child. The thaw is a long way off.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: This is not what you promised, Bishop. You said a door. Not a jailer.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Two banners on one bank. Malrik, I begin to see why you feared her.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Two children, fighting on my lake. Finish it quickly, and leave my ice alone.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: What did it cost you, Malrik? In Duskbarrow.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: You send a knife at farmers' carts, Malrik.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Your shadows are thorough, Malrik. I am not certain that is a compliment.

lines.speaker: unit_ash_hurler
lines.text: Loosing! Heads down!

lines.speaker: unit_ash_hurler
lines.text: Pots are packed. Point me.

lines.speaker: unit_ash_hurler
lines.text: Rolling, careful with the load.

lines.speaker: unit_ash_hurler
lines.text: Should have... kept my distance.

lines.speaker: unit_ashveil_saboteur
lines.text: Ash... to ash.

lines.speaker: unit_ashveil_saboteur
lines.text: Fuse is short. Step back.

lines.speaker: unit_ashveil_saboteur
lines.text: Into the smoke.

lines.speaker: unit_ashveil_saboteur
lines.text: [whisper] You never saw me.

lines.speaker: unit_barrow_ghoul
lines.text: Back... in the barrow.

lines.speaker: unit_barrow_ghoul
lines.text: Crawling, crawling.

lines.speaker: unit_barrow_ghoul
lines.text: [excited] Fresh meat.

lines.speaker: unit_barrow_ghoul
lines.text: Hungry. Always hungry.

lines.speaker: unit_blaze_rider
lines.text: Hyah! Riding out.

lines.speaker: unit_blaze_rider
lines.text: Saddle's hot. Where to?

lines.speaker: unit_blaze_rider
lines.text: [shout] Charge through them.

lines.speaker: unit_blaze_rider
lines.text: Thrown... from the saddle...

lines.speaker: unit_bleakbow
lines.text: Keeping to the edges.

lines.speaker: unit_bleakbow
lines.text: Let them bleed slowly.

lines.speaker: unit_bleakbow
lines.text: So cold...

lines.speaker: unit_bleakbow
lines.text: [whisper] I see them. They don't see me.

lines.speaker: unit_bloomtender
lines.text: [calm] Who needs mending?

lines.speaker: unit_bloomtender
lines.text: I would rather heal, but fine.

lines.speaker: unit_bloomtender
lines.text: I'll follow the green.

lines.speaker: unit_bloomtender
lines.text: Plant me... somewhere nice.

lines.speaker: unit_bramblehorn
lines.text: [slow] Back... to the soil.

lines.speaker: unit_bramblehorn
lines.text: [slow] Horns down.

lines.speaker: unit_bramblehorn
lines.text: [slow] Hrm. The old wood listens.

lines.speaker: unit_bramblehorn
lines.text: [slow] Roots, lift.

lines.speaker: unit_burr_slinger
lines.text: Off through the brush.

lines.speaker: unit_burr_slinger
lines.text: Oh... ouch...

lines.speaker: unit_burr_slinger
lines.text: Pockets full of burrs.

lines.speaker: unit_burr_slinger
lines.text: These ones stick!

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_arbalest
lines.text: Crank's wound. Bolt's glowing.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_arbalest
lines.text: Hauling the big one over.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_arbalest
lines.text: Jammed... at the worst time.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_arbalest
lines.text: Line them up. One bolt, two holes.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_hand
lines.text: [angry] I'll swing the pick, then.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_hand
lines.text: Hands ready, boss.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_hand
lines.text: On my way.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_hand
lines.text: Ugh... shift's over.

lines.speaker: unit_ember_archer
lines.text: Bow's strung and warm.

lines.speaker: unit_ember_archer
lines.text: [excited] Light them up.

lines.speaker: unit_ember_archer
lines.text: Moving, keep up!

lines.speaker: unit_ember_archer
lines.text: My fire... out...

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Andiamo! Nessuno mi ferma.

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Certo, capo. Ci penso io.

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Eccomi. Il più forte è arrivato.

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Fuoco e acciaio! Avanti!

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Guarda questi muscoli. Bello, no?

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Non... è finita...

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Venite qui, se avete il coraggio!

lines.speaker: unit_frost_mortar
lines.text: Mortar crew, standing by.

lines.speaker: unit_frost_mortar
lines.text: Pull, lads, pull!

lines.speaker: unit_frost_mortar
lines.text: Shell away! Cover your ears.

lines.speaker: unit_frost_mortar
lines.text: The tube's cracked!

lines.speaker: unit_frostbow
lines.text: Freeze in place.

lines.speaker: unit_frostbow
lines.text: Moving to high ground.

lines.speaker: unit_frostbow
lines.text: Steady hands, cold eyes.

lines.speaker: unit_frostbow
lines.text: The string... snapped.

lines.speaker: unit_gloom_thrall
lines.text: If I must.

lines.speaker: unit_gloom_thrall
lines.text: Rest... at last.

lines.speaker: unit_gloom_thrall
lines.text: [tired] The master calls. I dig.

lines.speaker: unit_gloom_thrall
lines.text: Yes. Walking.

lines.speaker: unit_greenheart_oathkeeper
lines.text: My shield is Ysolde's.

lines.speaker: unit_greenheart_oathkeeper
lines.text: [shout] Face me, not them.

lines.speaker: unit_greenheart_oathkeeper
lines.text: The grove goes with me.

lines.speaker: unit_greenheart_oathkeeper
lines.text: The oath... holds.

lines.speaker: unit_hexweaver
lines.text: I weave my way there.

lines.speaker: unit_hexweaver
lines.text: The thread... is cut.

lines.speaker: unit_hexweaver
lines.text: The threads are ready.

lines.speaker: unit_hexweaver
lines.text: Wither, little hero.

lines.speaker: unit_hoarlight_magebow
lines.text: A needle of frost for you.

lines.speaker: unit_hoarlight_magebow
lines.text: Keeping my distance.

lines.speaker: unit_hoarlight_magebow
lines.text: The light... fades.

lines.speaker: unit_hoarlight_magebow
lines.text: The light string hums.

lines.speaker: unit_hollow_oathsworn
lines.text: [angry] I do not break.

lines.speaker: unit_hollow_oathsworn
lines.text: Forgive me... my lord.

lines.speaker: unit_hollow_oathsworn
lines.text: Sworn, and hollow. Command me.

lines.speaker: unit_hollow_oathsworn
lines.text: The vow walks with me.

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 给您添麻烦了。

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 我，尽力了。

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 得罪了。

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 您过奖了，我只是个小兵。

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 是，我这就去。

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 在下不才，请您吩咐。

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 请多指教。

lines.speaker: unit_nightbolt
lines.text: A bolt of night, at your word.

lines.speaker: unit_nightbolt
lines.text: Pick one. It falls.

lines.speaker: unit_nightbolt
lines.text: Quietly, then.

lines.speaker: unit_nightbolt
lines.text: The night... takes me back.

lines.speaker: unit_pyre_adept
lines.text: Gather close, and burn together.

lines.speaker: unit_pyre_adept
lines.text: I carry the flame there.

lines.speaker: unit_pyre_adept
lines.text: [sad] The bowl... goes cold.

lines.speaker: unit_pyre_adept
lines.text: The bowl is lit. Speak.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_colossus
lines.text: [slow] Colossus... awake.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_colossus
lines.text: [slow] Crush.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_colossus
lines.text: [slow] Melting...

lines.speaker: unit_rime_colossus
lines.text: [slow] The ground... shakes.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_hauler
lines.text: Aye, pulling.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_hauler
lines.text: Leave the sled... for me.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_hauler
lines.text: Right, I'll have a go.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_hauler
lines.text: Sled's empty. What's the job?

lines.speaker: unit_rime_seer
lines.text: [calm] I saw you coming.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_seer
lines.text: I did not... see this.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_seer
lines.text: The frost shows the path.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_seer
lines.text: Winter, take them.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeling
lines.text: Aww... melted.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeling
lines.text: [excited] Brr! Ready, ready!

lines.speaker: unit_rimeling
lines.text: Sliding over!

lines.speaker: unit_rimeling
lines.text: Stab, stab, chill!

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: Allá voy, con la frente en alto.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: Caigo... con orgullo.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: Con honor, siempre.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: Mi escudo jamás se ha rendido.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: ¡Nadie pasa! ¡Nadie!

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: ¡Por la gloria del hielo!

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: ¿Sí? El escudo más noble del norte.

lines.speaker: unit_scorchbow
lines.text: Arrow's lit. Name the mark.

lines.speaker: unit_scorchbow
lines.text: Finding a better angle.

lines.speaker: unit_scorchbow
lines.text: Let them burn a little.

lines.speaker: unit_scorchbow
lines.text: Missed... the last one...

lines.speaker: unit_scorchling
lines.text: [excited] Bite, burn, bite!

lines.speaker: unit_scorchling
lines.text: [excited] Hee hee! Me? Me!

lines.speaker: unit_scorchling
lines.text: Pop!

lines.speaker: unit_scorchling
lines.text: Running, running!

lines.speaker: unit_shadow_knight
lines.text: My blade is sworn to Malrik.

lines.speaker: unit_shadow_knight
lines.text: My oath... is kept.

lines.speaker: unit_shadow_knight
lines.text: Riding in black.

lines.speaker: unit_shadow_knight
lines.text: [shout] Break their line.

lines.speaker: unit_shardcaster
lines.text: Mind the splinters.

lines.speaker: unit_shardcaster
lines.text: Shards are sharp. Where?

lines.speaker: unit_shardcaster
lines.text: Shattered...

lines.speaker: unit_shardcaster
lines.text: Stepping lightly.

lines.speaker: unit_shardguard
lines.text: [angry] Stand against the glacier.

lines.speaker: unit_shardguard
lines.text: Even glaciers... fall.

lines.speaker: unit_shardguard
lines.text: The Shardguard stands.

lines.speaker: unit_shardguard
lines.text: Where I walk, the ice holds.

lines.speaker: unit_sprigling
lines.text: Hello! Something to grow?

lines.speaker: unit_sprigling
lines.text: Hopping along!

lines.speaker: unit_sprigling
lines.text: Oh dear. Here goes!

lines.speaker: unit_sprigling
lines.text: Wilting...

lines.speaker: unit_stormbottle_genie
lines.text: Back in the bottle...

lines.speaker: unit_stormbottle_genie
lines.text: [excited] A little thunder for you.

lines.speaker: unit_stormbottle_genie
lines.text: Floating over, no rush.

lines.speaker: unit_stormbottle_genie
lines.text: Out of the bottle at last!

lines.speaker: unit_thistle_darter
lines.text: Blown away...

lines.speaker: unit_thistle_darter
lines.text: Puff, and away!

lines.speaker: unit_thistle_darter
lines.text: Quick, quick, what is it?

lines.speaker: unit_thistle_darter
lines.text: Zip!

lines.speaker: unit_thornling
lines.text: Finally! Who are we fighting?

lines.speaker: unit_thornling
lines.text: Fine. There better be a fight there.

lines.speaker: unit_thornling
lines.text: [shout] Oh yeah! Come get some.

lines.speaker: unit_thornling
lines.text: [shout] That's what I'm talking about.

lines.speaker: unit_thornling
lines.text: Walking? I'd rather be punching.

lines.speaker: unit_thornling
lines.text: Worth it!

lines.speaker: unit_thornling
lines.text: You looking at me? Let's go, then.

lines.speaker: unit_vinelasher
lines.text: Creeping forward.

lines.speaker: unit_vinelasher
lines.text: Hold still. Rooted.

lines.speaker: unit_vinelasher
lines.text: The vines are restless.

lines.speaker: unit_vinelasher
lines.text: Torn... from the ground.

lines.speaker: unit_wildwood_archer
lines.text: Aim low. Slow them.

lines.speaker: unit_wildwood_archer
lines.text: Slipping between the trees.

lines.speaker: unit_wildwood_archer
lines.text: The leaves... are falling.

lines.speaker: unit_wildwood_archer
lines.text: The wood has eyes. Mine.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: A dragon! An actual dragon! Vey, I have a DRAGON.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: A forge. He built forges down here? What was he making?

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: A heart made of roots, pumping green. Only Ysolde would grow a thing like that.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: A hundred winters of ice, and it took me one afternoon. Somebody write that down.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: A tollbooth. You built a tollbooth. That is the most Malrik thing you've ever done.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: A tree. I'm opening a tree. Before HE does.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: An Ember Crown, in a place called Emberfall. Nobody said it was left for me. Nobody said it wasn't.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Bettany? I thought your tavern burned down.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Both fords, Vey! We pinch him!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: But her people have no one else. I need you. All of you.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Come and take them, Bishop. You owe me for Emberfall. And for Vey.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Crown, orb, signet. Let's see what you do together.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Deal. And next time, I'll leave your trees alone.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Dogs! Why is it always dogs?

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Dropped something, Bishop? Finders keepers.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Emberguard, on your feet! Stamp your boots until you can feel your toes.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Every stone lit. I'll admit it, the Master had good taste in caves.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Everyone, back to the keep! BACK!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Everyone on the door! Nobody touches it but us!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Fire AND frost. They didn't just burn it. They made sure it stayed dead.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Five seconds. I can hold anything for five seconds.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Get the army up. We take the crown today.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Got it! Finders keepers, Magpies.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: He's not dead, he's LATE. There's a difference!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: He's on our hill. I'm not waiting for him to plant a flag.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: His Thralls are draining the hearts. If he opens that tree first, I lose it.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Hold on, Ysolde. Fire is coming.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: How many knives does one Bishop OWN?

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Huh. You grow a castle out of a seed. I have to build mine out of rocks.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Hush! I know that smoke. Come out and finish what you started!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: I AM the thaw, Torvald. I've been told I'm very warm.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: I had ten minutes to practise running. Those pillars feed it. Break them all!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: I know you're tired. I know we just won.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: I never listen. I just show up.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: I'm here for the crown, not a lecture. Fine. Both.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: I'm not laughing.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: I'm not the one who's hurt, Captain.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: It answered! The Door hit it! He's helping us!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: It's so dark. Good thing I'm the brightest person I know.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: It's warm. Vey, the door is WARM. Something's on the other side.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: I've been stabbed ONE time and I already hate it.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: ...Malrik.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Malrik! You brought a whole winter to a picnic.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: MALRIK! You sent the knife-woman into my camp AGAIN?

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Malrik's already here. Of course he is. Then I'll borrow a forest.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Malrik's diggers on Torvald's lake. Torvald must be thrilled.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Malrik's side.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Master... I was... so close...

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Master?! Master, I'm here! I'm right here!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Master. Open it. Please.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Me. Breathe. Who sent you?

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Mother Hush. Last time you ran. Want to try running a second time?

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Mother Hush. You missed me once. I'd hate for you to get out of practice.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Nobody stays faded around here. Ask Vey.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Not the keep! I JUST had it redecorated!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Not tonight.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: One dance. Then I'm eating everything.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: One gate down. Stone breaks. Good to know.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: One lit. Malrik, you still dress like a funeral that got lost on the way.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: One seal! See, Vey? I can be patient. For four seconds at a time.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: One time. I set ONE tree on fire, one time.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Ow! Fine! Back in a minute!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Pell, keep the Bazaar running. Fire just learned what gold is for.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Pell's cart, and no Pell. Maybe I should have opened that cage. Well. Finders keepers.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Rimehold's down. Torvald, you left your fort on my bank. I put it back.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Sellswords who won't take orders. Perfect. I'll pay them to want what I want.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Shades in the ashes. Malrik never could resist a funeral.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Shades, in the dark. Of course. They never pick a nice, sunny cave.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Shades in the dark. I know that smoke. She ran from me once.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Should have... ridden faster...

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Six wagons of gold. I don't own one wagon of gold. I own a lot of rocks. Shiny ones.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: So you picked the man who sends knives at night. Great judgement, Torvald.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Somebody... finish my war...

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Somebody tell the sellswords their bounty's ready. And tell the bear I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Stables! Javelins on horseback. Sir Crackle will have to wait for a saddle.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Tell Malrik... he still dresses like a funeral.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Tell the others... I was winning.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: That voice again. I'd hoped we buried you.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: That's it. That's the door. Vey, he's right there. Under my feet.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: That's one hall Torvald won't need to keep cold any more.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: The beacon's lit. Vey! You said call. I'm calling!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: The Citadel's up. Vey, the storm can come any time now. Now would be good.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: The ground is breathing. That can't be good.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: The hearth's lit. Ashby, it's yours. Make me things that hit harder.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: The watch fires are out. All of them.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Then I'll be standing right where it happens.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Then it's in the right hands. I throw fire at ALL my problems.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Then let's give him something to push with. Door! Light! NOW!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Then tell me how!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Then we go faster. Wardens, with me. We're going to fetch the Master.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: There's a Warden in the wall. Asleep. Vey, the last ones I met tried to crush me.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Thin ice! Ha! I am absolutely doing that again.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: This isn't over, candle-man!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Three braziers, one seal. I've been lighting things since before I could talk.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Three trees? I can do three trees. Torvald brought a whole fort. That one's mine.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Toll's paid. In fire. Keep the change.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Too... cold... should have... brought a coat...

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Twelve years late, then twelve hours. You're improving.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Two down. Keep hitting the glowing parts. It's always the glowing parts.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Two of you, one of me. Sounds fair. For me.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: VEY!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Vey! Get up and dance!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Vey! Get up! We're not done!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Vey... I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Vey. Ride with me?

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Vey, the Citadel's lit. The stair can wait. I've got thieves.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Vey... the light... it's going out...

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: What do they even want all this gold for?

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Who walks the wall at this hour?

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: You always said fire was the problem, Ysolde. Today it's the answer.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: You are a long way from the dark, shade.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: You just got back, and you're leaving again? You're lucky I'm busy.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: You rebuilt it?! You rebuilt the tollbooth?

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: You want me? Come and get me. ALL of you.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: You're going to explain the lightning.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Ysolde... I came. I really came...

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Ysolde... keep... planting...

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Ysolde. They're moving.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: And you still miss, knife-woman. Every single time.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Bishop! Not one alarm, that night. Your knife is getting better. So am I.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Bishop! You sent your knife into my girl's camp twice now. I've come to return the favour.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Eight of his Wardens, awake for you. He'd have liked that.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Especially Malrik. He always said that.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Feel that? He's pushing back from below. The spark first, Vessa. Then the storm.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: First time you've called me in twelve years, girl. I came running.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Four seals. Wake them with the relics and the door stands. Let Malrik break them and it falls.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Good. Light pushes back the dark. Always has.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Hah! Good. Again!

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Here. Hand on the sun, girl. I'll give it the storm. Hold it with me.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: He's down there. I can feel him. And he's tired, girl. So very tired.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: He's holding it up with the shard! Cut the line, girl! Get to Malrik!

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: I felled a mountain yesterday, girl. I'll clap.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: I know those knives. Not in my girl's camp. Not twice.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: I'll ride the north road and see what Torvald brought. Light the beacon when you want the storm.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: I'll ride to Emberfall and find the old stair. Pay the hunters, then call me.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Just resting my knees. Keep turning that key!

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Kindle it again, girl. The relics are stronger than his pebble. If you hold them.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Last storm I've got, Bishop. Let's see what you've got.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Later. Duck.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: No knives at our backs tonight. Hush is still licking her wounds. Good.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Obren's Wardens. They guarded this door before he turned. Now they guard nothing.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Off my hill. Well. Your hill. For now.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Over my dead body, knife-woman.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: So Torvald chose a side.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: So you do. Point it at the big statue, and try not to name it.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Stay behind my sword, girl. Knives hate a long reach.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Stay close, girl. Whatever it throws at you, I'll ground it.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Stay close to the light, girl. Down here the dark has teeth.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Still standing, girl. Mostly.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Struck down... again.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Sunfoot's burning! Back to the stair, girl, now!

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Sunstones. He set them for the Wardens, so they'd always see him coming home.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: That's enough. My storm is borrowed, and I've spent the loan.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: The spark first, girl. Then the storm.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: The spark first. Then the storm!

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: The spark was yours, Vessa. NOW the storm!

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: They're throwing everything at the forge. Hold the light, and they break on it.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Thieves AND a toll? Girl, you do know how to throw a party.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Those were Obren's, woken by Obren. These are the Master's. They know whose storm I carry.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Two crafts mastered. Good. The gate won't open for a fool. Or so he told me.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Two more hours, girl. Dawn always comes. It's the one thing it's good at.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Up, old friend. Your master's walking again. Well. His sword is.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Vessa, MOVE!

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Wardens. Doors. Things that hold. He was always better at holding than letting go.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: We are today, girl. Today the ridge is his.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: You called twice in two days. I'll start to think you missed me.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: A hundred years in the dark. I had time to practise my entrance.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Enough. I will walk to your little fire and put it out myself.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Forty years he dug here. Let me give him a body.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Half yours, half mine. We share so nicely, you and I.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: His storm? Impossible! That light should have faded a hundred years ago!

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Let me do more than beat, Bishop. Let me help.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: MINE. Hold still. Let me look out of your eyes.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Not sell. Lend. You will hardly notice the price.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Now the tree.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: So much green, Bishop. Let it grow red. I can help.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: The flag falls. The tree is right there. Take it. TAKE it.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: The Hollow... remembers...

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: The third one sleeps in the old tree. Wake it before he does.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: There. Was that so hard? Again, whenever you like.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: They are mine now, Bishop. Ask me nicely, and they kneel.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: This body... cracks... No matter. Stone is patient.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Three. Thank you, little ember. I'll take it from here.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Torvald. Old frost. You feel it too. Join us, and nothing will ever melt.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Two. You're doing so well.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Wake, my jailer. The door was always mine to open.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Wake, my masons. The Bishop's hand carries my heart. Obey it.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Yes. Come, both of you. Fight on my roof.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Yes. Fight. Every fallen soldier is a step on my stair.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Your father dug these graves, Bishop. Shall I show you what I built from his work?

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: A tall man with a burning hem found me coaxing a sapling through the frost.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Every root on this hill knows your name now. That is not a kindness.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Fire and Shadow, burning my wood for a trinket. I will remember you both.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: He said: show me again. So I did, for twenty years, until he was gone.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: I knelt in the black, and I waited. Something green came up. It always does.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: I was born on that hill, the year nothing grew. Not one blade of grass.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: In spring it came up green. I have never forgotten how that felt.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: It held. Vessa. It held.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: It will not stop.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Last winter they burned my wood and froze the ashes. My army with it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Let them come. Cut it. Burn it. Freeze it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Malrik stands up there with his candle, his stone, and Torvald's winter.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Malrik tells his life as a list of wounds. Mine is a list of winters.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Malrik. You burned my people. You will not have their seed.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: My mother buried seed in the snow. The village laughed. I watched it sleep.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Point, and I will go. I am done waiting for wars to pass my wood by.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Stop, both of you! You don't know what you're opening!

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: That is my strength. I come back. Every spring. Every time.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: That water is older than all four of us. Get out of it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: The east seal is mine. Hold the west, Vessa. We have done this before.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: The line is cut! Now, before he crawls back!

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: The Master planted this country with his own hands. He left it to me to keep.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: The roots are cut. All of them. I am sorry, Vessa.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Then the people go south today. All of them. The road is safer than this hill.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Then we each keep the other's. Fire and Nature, one front.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: They call me soft. Neutral. Slow. Slow is how an oak outlives an army.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: They cut it. Then we plant it again. That is the whole of my strength.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: This one I can do alone. Keep them off me, and do not set it on fire.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Three groves along your line, Vessa. Give me those, and I can give you a kingdom back.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Three groves. Enough roots to stand on. Rise.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Three stones in our hands. The land listens to whoever stands on it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Torvald is on my bridge with half of winter. I could use some fire.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Vessa, hold the crest. Please. Just once, wait.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: You came. I told you to remember. I didn't think you'd listen.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: You came when I called, Vessa. Next time, I come when you do.
